title: Enterprise redline prioritization via usage-profile risk scoring
creator: Priya Desai
description:
Problem: Sales and Legal spend disproportionate time triaging MSA/DPA redlines that vary widely in risk versus expected revenue. Current triage is manual and timestamped only by queue order, which increases SLA slippage and forces blanket conservative concessions in pricing experiments.

Goal: Design and prototype an automated prioritization and routing system that scores contract redlines (MSA/DPA) using customer usage profiles, expected ARR, indemnity/liability exposure heuristics, and responses to Security Questionnaires (SSQs). The system should produce a recommended triage queue for Legal and Sales Ops, surface recommended concessions or escalate to ‘enterprise review’, and allow A/B testing against current manual triage to measure SLA reduction and pricing impact.

Scope: This ticket covers PM and design of scoring model, telemetry schema for usage profiles, integration points with Sales intake form and Legal review board, a lightweight prototype in Google Sheets + scoring rules, and a short pilot with two AE pods. Engineering and Legal integrations (SSQ parser, signature flows) will be separate follow-ups once pilot validates signals.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype scoring model exists as a spreadsheet that takes: ARR, monthly usage, feature flags (Dedicated/Private), SSQ risk flags, and requested indemnity caps and outputs a priority score and recommended concession band.
Integration spec written for Sales intake form and Legal queue that includes required fields, webhook payload, and example mappings to priority score.
Pilot plan defined and signed off by Sales, Legal, and Finance including success metrics (median triage SLA, % of contracts auto-approved within concession band, change in expected margin).
Runbook for legal reviewers with recommended concession ranges per score band and required escalation thresholds is drafted and reviewed.
Experiment dashboard mockups in Confluence showing target metrics and segmentation by customer segment are attached.
decisions: Use a hybrid heuristic score (ARR weighted x0.5, monthly usage x0.3, ssq_risk x0.2) for initial pilot; weights adjustable after pilot.
Auto-approve low-risk redlines within conservative concession bands up to $50k ARR; medium/high require Legal review with priority ordering.
Integrate initial signals with existing Sales intake form; defer automated SSQ parsing integration until after spreadsheet prototype validates signal value.
next_steps: Deliver spreadsheet prototype and walkthrough to Legal and two AE pods by 2025-02-17.
Collect 15 real redline examples and score them with the prototype for manual validation (Legal + Sales).
Finalize integration spec and webhook schema for Eng to implement in a follow-up ticket if pilot metrics meet success criteria.
Schedule pilot retrospective and metric review on 2025-03-16 to decide rollout or iterate.
